goal: Coverage-before-depth across independent natal, historical, electional, divinatory and cross-cultural traditions

traditions.first_reference_texts: Vettius Valens, Anthologies; Dorotheus of Sidon, Carmen Astrologicum
traditions.reason_for_priority: Source differences from Ptolemy/Lilly matter for timing, chronocrators, technique and independent original-rule maps. Riley translation is openly posted but incomplete; Dorotheus survives through Arabic mediation.

traditions.first_reference_texts: Abu Ma'shar Great Introduction; al-Biruni Book of Instruction; al-Qabisi
traditions.reason_for_priority: Independent bridges between classical Greek/Indian/Arabic medieval methods and later Lilly; historical original Arabic/Persian and translation lineages, lots, profections, elections and annual revolutions.

traditions.first_reference_texts: Florentine Codex Book IV; Codex Borgia; Elizabeth Hill Boone
traditions.reason_for_priority: Related 260-day divination but separate from Maya, with direct historical birth-day prognostic material; cross-cultural comparison should avoid treating it as a second independent unrelated clock.

traditions.first_reference_texts: Francesca Rochberg The Heavenly Writing; documented Babylonian horoscope tablets
traditions.reason_for_priority: Historical precursor; separates personal horoscopes and royal/collective omen claims; important transmission but perhaps lower marginal behavioral signal than missing original Hellenistic natal texts.

traditions.tradition_class: Qi Men Dun Jia question-time/electional and other Chinese divination
traditions.first_reference_texts: Early and later printed Chinese Qi Men Dun Jia methods, version/era critical editions required
traditions.reason_for_priority: Method/phenotype space distinct from Zi Wei and BaZi, but often question- or date-of-action divination rather than birth-derived stable personality.

traditions.tradition_class: Burmese, Thai and related weekday natal astrology
traditions.first_reference_texts: Documented Mahabote and weekday birth traditions, identify authoritative local-language sources first
traditions.reason_for_priority: Potential independent coarse weekday/pattern structures, but culture-specific source provenance and calendar alignment must be researched before scoring.

traditions.tradition_class: Ifa, geomancy and other ritual systems
traditions.first_reference_texts: Traditional original cultural knowledge, not automatically an astronomical natal horoscope
traditions.reason_for_priority: Separate comparative divination practice only with legitimate source/cultural context; don't present as missing horoscopic astrology.
